
### constructing routing/neighbor tables  {.smaller}


* interesting task: how to fill tables
* two general strategies: 
<hr class="vspace" />
* routers/switches learn from neighbors 

   * ‘‘distributed’’
   * what we'll mainly cover
   * historically most common design

* information gathered on single controller machine <br> which configures routers/switches 

   * ‘‘centralized’’
   * more common/easier with software defined network approaches
